mensagens.input: The world record for texting is about 6100 messages per day. Miki decided to see if she could beat that record. Please help her figure out how close she came.<br><br>Part 1) One day in July, Miki sent 2257 messages. This is what percentage of the record?<br><br>Part 2) One hot day in August Miki sent 1159 messages. What percentage of the record is this?
